pinned_x_draft: I make Ssak for days when the original plan feels too big. Set two reading options in advance: ten minutes on a usual day, one page on a busy one. Record what you read. One habit is free on iOS and Android. https://ssak-habit-tracker.pages.dev/landing/reading/

shots: 0–3s: A bookmark in a closed book. Too tired for ten minutes?
3–7s: Open the book and turn one page. Tonight: one page.
7–12s: Show the smaller option on Today, then its recorded result.
12–15s: Read one page. Record one page.
